0022600097.text: The Wizards are 1-0 and host the 1-0 Raptors in Washington's second game of the season, with Washington 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East and Toronto 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the East. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Felix Okpara is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 134-125 defeat in Washington on February 28, 2026.
